mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active when the rate is at or below the threshold.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, the S&P 500 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates a weak labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 9.0, the S&P 500 5d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.2% and the CPI index is at or below 218, the combination of low interest rates and low inflation compresses discount rates and reduces inflation risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rate environment
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2 AND CPIAUCSL <= 218, the S&P 500 60d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 9.0, the S&P 500 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 550 thousand units indicates a depressed housing market, which is a leading indicator of weak economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 550, the S&P 500 5d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550 thousand units and residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 360,000 million dollars, the combined weakness in the housing sector signals a broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 550 AND RSAFS < 360000, the S&P 500 60d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 90, the S&P 500 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90 and the CPI index remains below 218, the combination signals a recessionary environment with low growth and low inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 90 AND CPIAUCSL < 218, the S&P 500 5d returns are positive.
